sonic-3.6-2026-08-27.pricingNotes: Scale costs $299/month for 8,000,000 credits; standard TTS uses approximately one credit per character (https://docs.cartesia.ai/pricing). At full credit utilization this is $37.375/M characters, or 3.7375 cents/1K. This is an allocation estimate, not a universal pay-as-you-go or overage rate. Preprocessing, unused credits, other plans, clones, taxes and enterprise terms can change actual costs.
